invariants.rationale: The method always throws an exception, so it should never return a value, meaning 'result' must always be null at the exit point.
Non-nullness of input parameters is typically required for any real method logic to execute before the exception is thrown.
It is standard in Hudi codebase to require index definitions to be non-null for index-related APIs.
The meta client is a required context parameter for metadata operations, and methods typically assume it is not null.

invariants.rationale: The method unconditionally throws, so no normal return path can be completed; expression symbolically asserts the unconditional throw.
